title_en: MODERN VILLA IN FOREST RESIDENCE – DRY LAKE
description_en: ATTACHED VILLA TO FOREST RESIDENCE LIQENI I THATHE, TIRANA We have for sale a new, newly invested and furnished villa of very high quality, positioned in one of the most sought-after residences in the elite area of ​​Dry Lake.
